neighbours.label: Getting or packing personal gear in preparation for an activity
fire: Grab your hiking boots and join us on the trail.
So get out your paintbrushes and start the mural.
I pulled out my suitcase to prepare for the holiday.
She packed her camera before heading to the coast.
Break out your knitting needles for an evening of crafts.
Get your fishing rod ready for tomorrow morning.
We put on our helmets and set off for a ride.
He grabbed his tennis racket and hurried to the court.
quiet: Inspect your hiking boots after returning from the trail.
So clean off your paintbrushes after finishing the mural.
I repaired my suitcase after returning from the holiday.
She cleaned her camera after returning from the coast.
Put away your knitting needles after an evening of crafts.
Keep your fishing rod dry until tomorrow morning.
We inspected our helmets after finishing a ride.
He repaired his tennis racket after leaving the court.

notes: Card peaks include grab/get/pack and possessives around equipment. This is a tentative preparation context, not a general possession label. Labels use the card and top 16 corpus examples. No downloaded band scan covers this neuron. Test sentences were authored by Codex, not Bonsai.
